evidence: Elam et al. studied A L Do fA l 2O3 and ZnO in ultrahigh-aspect-ratio nanopores of anodic aluminum oxide (AAO) membranes. The Al 2O3 coating was veriﬁed by plan-view scanning electron microscopy images recorded from the top, middle, and bottom portions of the membranes, and the ZnO coverage was quantiﬁed using electron probe microanalysis line scans. A Woollam M-2000 ellipsometer was used to accurately measure the ﬁlm thickness as a function of depth inside the hole.
